text: ~/sufr-benchmarks on catalyst (ssh catalyst: 2 x Xeon 8568Y+, 192 CPUs, 1 TB RAM, shared) is jeb's suffix-bench copied on 2026-11-05 with the paper's inputs hg38, hg38noN, hs1 and uniprot_sprot. sufr/ there is the checkout under test and vendor/sufr/sufr links to its release build. ./run-paper1gen.sh writes results/paper1gen-<commit>.csv and .tbl: 32 threads, 2000 partitions, no cap and no --dna, as the paper's table in results/paper1gen.tbl was run.
